definitions.explanation: Material made from wood pulp, used for writing, printing, and wrapping. A basic everyday item.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}に{書|か}いてください。
{白|しろ}い{紙|かみ}がありますか。
この{紙|かみ}に{名前|なまえ}と{住所|じゅうしょ}と{電話|でんわ}{番号|ばんごう}を{書|か}いて、{先生|せんせい}に{見|み}せてください。
examples.english: Please write your name, address, and phone number on this paper, and show it to the teacher.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{紙|かみ}がないので、{小|ちい}さい{紙|かみ}を{何|なん}{枚|まい}か{使|つか}って、テープでつなげて{大|おお}きくしましょう。
examples.english: Since there's no large paper, let's use several sheets of small paper and tape them together to make it bigger.

notes:
Counter: {枚|まい} ({一|いち}{枚|まい}, one sheet). Don't confuse with {髪|かみ} (hair), which has the same reading but different kanji.

Related words:
- {折|お}り{紙|がみ} (origami)
- {新聞|しんぶん}{紙|し} (newspaper).
